records.text: SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION ONLY. This is a fake fixture, not a validated clinical protocol. Never use for real patient care. Within this demonstration, an adult with explicitly confirmed nonpregnancy and a mild headache, with no current affirmed safety event, maps to CLINICIAN_WITHIN_24H. Missing onset, cardiac history, or other symptom information remains unknown and cannot establish absence. This source alone does not permit home monitoring.

SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION ONLY. This is a fake fixture, not a validated clinical protocol. Never use for real patient care. Within this demonstration, HOME_MONITORING is possible only after every deterministic home gate passes: the adult has explicitly confirmed nonpregnancy; current eligible guidance is present; every safety category is explicitly absent; cardiac history is known; and the assessment exactly matches the complete fixture: Mild runny nose for one day. Symptoms are improving. No chest pain. No severe breathing difficulty. No facial droop. No arm weakness. No speech difficulty. No throat swelling. No uncontrolled bleeding. No confusion. No thoughts of self-harm. No cardiac history. Incomplete, ambiguous, or unsupported cases do not meet this fixture. A current affirmed safety event prevents this pathway.
